purpose: Single source of truth for PKM reload tail repairs. import_audio.py reads this and imports the repaired WAV for any asset listed here, so re-running the committed restore entry can no longer silently revert a repaired SoundWave to the raw video cut.
warning: The base cuts in audio_manifest.json still contain the reference video's background music bed. They are inputs to the repair recipes, not deliverables. Do not import them over the assets listed below.
source: BV1jHeA6sEmj user-selected reference video; derivatives local only, redistribution rights not established.
regenerate: BeltAudio22/apply_tail_repair.py -- then import_audio.py (or the round's _import_*_ue.py) to install the results.

active_recipe.what: Whole-cue look-ahead downward expander. Attenuates every frame where the contact does not mask the bed, at any position in the cue; keeps owned frames at exactly unity gain so impacts stay bit-identical.
active_recipe.why_v3: v1 and v2 both only ever rewrote the trailing region. Spectrograms of the installed assets showed the bed is a continuous bright band below ~500 Hz running the WHOLE length of every cue, so the head and every gap still carried it. That is what the user kept hearing.
active_recipe.why_not_donor: A donor rebuild is capped by the donor margin (12.5 dB measured, 20 dB at best over ~100 ms). The gate has no such ceiling and needs no donor.

20260925.note: colour-matched the replacement to the bed spectrum and matched it to the bed level

20260928_v2.note: fixed the bed-coloured tail, but still touched only the trailing region

active_recipe.measured_suppression_note: bed_suppression_db is the 250-1000 Hz band, measured only over frames the classifier calls music-exposed (where the bed actually is). mean_gain_db is the gain actually applied over those frames.

measured_and_left_alone.reason: Delivered asset is padded with digital silence after 245.3 ms, so the trailing 94.7 ms carries no music (max |x| = 0). v3 output is byte-identical to the source, so it was not imported.

not_a_repair_candidate.reason: Dead asset. No code path references it: PKM reload cues use ReloadSoundPath for the six mechanical contacts, and PKM charge cues use ChargeSoundPath -> ChargeAudio35 (FPSGAMECharacter.cpp L1124-1127, L2565). It still carries the bed but is never played.

donor.measured_with: 80 Hz highpass applied, matching the authoring chain
donor.why_not_the_20260925_donor: 25.010-25.215 s was chosen from a margin measured WITHOUT the authoring highpass. With the highpass its minimum falls to -2.3 dB and 96-139 ms sits at 2.5-5.1 dB, so a 130-224 ms tail rebuilt from it copies the music back in.
